definition: Quarters between a move in a sub-layer's venture dollars and the matching move in that sub-layer's revenue (Appendix C venture measures).
name: Venture flow's lead or lag against sub-layer revenue (quarters)
timing_rationale: Leading: the whole measure is how far venture dollars move ahead of the revenue they are betting on.
unpublished_reason: Two things are missing: revenue by sub-layer, which only the labs report and only as press-relayed run-rates, and enough quarters to cross-correlate against. The venture series starts in 2023 and eight quarters of both sides are needed before a lag is more than noise.
why_it_matters: Capital arriving before revenue is a bet on a sub-layer; capital arriving after it is a response to one. The sign and size of the lag say which.
